question:
The sentence given below contains some spelling errors. Select the option that has the correct spellings.

Appliications of subjects like Physiks and chemmistry in our dayly life also have higher visibelity than those of Biology.

options.text: Applicasions of subjects like Physiks and Cemistry in our dayly life also have higher visibility than those of Biology.
Appliications of subjects like Physics and chemistry in our dayly life also have higher visibelity than those of Biology.
Applications of subjects like Physics and Chemistry in our daily life also have higher visibility than those of Biology.
Applicacions of subjects like Physics and chemmistry in our daily life also have higher visibilety than those of Biology.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Applications"** means the action of putting something into operation. (अनुप्रयोग)

 
 
• **Example:** The applications of this technology are numerous and varied.
 
 
 
• **"Physics"** refers to the natural science that studies matter, its motion, and behavior through space and time. (भौतिकी)
 
 
• **Example:** She has a deep interest in Physics and plans to pursue it at the university level.
 
 
 
• **"Chemistry"** refers to the branch of science that studies the properties and behavior of matter. (रसायन विज्ञान)
 
 
• **Example:** Chemistry plays a crucial role in the development of new medicines.
 
 
 
• **"Daily"** means happening or used every day; everyday. (दैनिक)
 
 
• **Example:** She maintains a daily journal to record her thoughts and experiences.
 
 
 
• **"Visibility"** refers to the state of being able to see or be seen. (दृश्यता)
 
 
• **Example:** The fog reduced visibility on the roads significantly.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 1:** Applicasions of subjects like Physiks and Cemistry in our dayly life also have higher visibility than those of Biology.

 
 
• 'Applicasions' (अनुप्रयोग) is an incorrect spelling of 'applications'.
 
• 'Physiks' (भौतिकी) is an incorrect spelling of 'physics'.
 
• 'Cemistry' (रसायन विज्ञान) is an incorrect spelling of 'chemistry'.
 
• 'Dayly' (दैनिक) is an incorrect spelling of 'daily'.
 
 
 
• **Option 2:** Appliications of subjects like Physics and chemistry in our dayly life also have higher visibelity than those of Biology.
 
 
• 'Appliications' (अनुप्रयोग) is an incorrect spelling of 'applications'.
 
• 'Dayly' (दैनिक) is an incorrect spelling of 'daily'.
 
• 'Visibelity' (दृश्यता) is an incorrect spelling of 'visibility'.
 
 
 
• **Option 4:** Applicacions of subjects like Physics and chemmistry in our daily life also have higher visibilety than those of Biology.
 
 
• 'Applicacions' (अनुप्रयोग) is an incorrect spelling of 'applications'.
 
• 'Chemmistry' (रसायन विज्ञान) is an incorrect spelling of 'chemistry'.
 
• 'Visibilety' (दृश्यता) is an incorrect spelling of 'visibility'.
 
 

1e3:Ted4,

The correct answer is **Option 4)**
